main_text.l: scrí‐pto nitetur, eum re exposita, recita‐
rogare, num aut scriptū neget, aut
cem ad uím scripti uocet: hac cōfir‐
qui cum palàm contra fecerit, idq;
se, aliud sensisse scriptorē, aliud scrí‐
psisse dicat, nō esse ferendū, à quo‐
à lege explicari. cur ita scripserit, si
ita non senserit? Cur cum ea, quæ

page.notes: Lower part of the page: "E ş adé" printed at the foot; treated as signature and catchword. Some words in the scan are blurred; readings such as "scripsisse", "damnan‐dos" are doubtful.
